<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book an Appointment">15b0f15983cba21040a9c8efeeaad3c4</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:fd968f118383e21040a9c8efeeaad358</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Load Doctors on Department</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || !newValue) return;

    var ga = new GlideAjax('DoctorUtils');
	var dept = g_form.getValue('v_department');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getDoctorsByDepartmentName');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_department_name', dept);

    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response) {
        var doctors = JSON.parse(response);

        g_form.clearOptions('v_doctor');
        for (var i = 0; i < doctors.length; i++) {
            g_form.addOption('v_doctor', doctors[i].doctor_id);
        }
    });
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-30 17:45:06</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7033697d830f221040a9c8efeeaad3a6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Load Doctors on Department</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Healthcare Management Application" source="ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Healthcare Management Application">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_7033697d830f221040a9c8efeeaad3a6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-31 05:45:40</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
